description_en: Places an order to purchase an edge smart gateway agent package
description_zh: 下单购买边缘智能体套餐包
name: CreateEdgeMobileAgentPackage

parameters.help_en: The region where the agent is located
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration of the resource. The unit is specified by PeriodUnit
parameters.help_zh: 购买资源的时长，单位由`PeriodUnit`指定
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

Month: month.
Year: year
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长单位。
取值范围：
Month：月。
Year：年
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false (default): disables auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
实例是否自动续费，取值：

true：是
false（默认）：否
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true: enables automatic payment. Make sure that your account balance is sufficient.
false (default): generates the order without charging the account.




If your payment method has an insufficient balance, set this parameter to false. An unpaid order is generated. You can then log on to the Cloud Phone console to complete the payment
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付。取值范围：

true：自动支付。您需要确保账户余额充足。
false（默认）：只生成订单不扣费。




如果您的支付方式余额不足，可以将此参数设置为false，此时会生成未支付订单，您可以登录无影云手机管理控制台自行支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The ID of the promotional activity
parameters.name: promotion_id
